title: A time-bounded check states its margin against the run-to-run spread on a loaded host
goal: A check that bounds measured times (a panel budget) states its margin against the run-to-run spread on a loaded host, load near the core count, since land runs the checks while other landings run (BG-2n4csy5p's 10 s all-panels check failed as a sibling at load 11.7 of 14 cores); the sprint skill's plan step and kb/_self/backlog.md (Sprints, Plan) say so.

run: import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','what host load does a time-bounded check\'s margin assume'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and 'loaded host' in p.stdout else 1)
